tooltip: AWB Presets – Locks auto white balance and selects a preset lighting condition.
content1: Selects a fixed white balance preset (Cloudy, Daylight, Flash, Cool White Fluorescent, Tungsten, Candlelight, Horizon, Custom, or Auto), and optionally locks AWB at its current value.
content2: Preset mode - GET 0x03, SET 0x04. AWB lock - GET 0x05, SET 0x06.
getAPIDes: Reads the current AWB preset and lock state.
setAPIDes: Sets the AWB preset and/or locks AWB.

tooltip: Q-Factor – Adjusts the JPEG compression quality factor.
content1: Controls the JPEG quality factor used for encoding, from 0 (lowest quality/highest compression) to 100.

tooltip: AE Metering Mode – Selects the auto exposure metering region and optionally locks AE.
content1: Selects Manual, Center-Weighted Average, All Block Integral, Spot1 (small area), or Spot2 (large area) exposure metering, and optionally locks AE at its current value.
content2: Metering mode - GET 0x07, SET 0x08. AE lock - GET 0x09, SET 0x0A.
getAPIDes: Reads the current AE metering mode and lock state.
setAPIDes: Sets the AE metering mode and/or locks AE.

tooltip: Image Capture – Sets the still capture burst length.
content1: Selects the number of frames (1 through 5) captured in a single still-capture burst.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Configures automatic, 50 Hz, 60 Hz, or disabled flicker suppression.
content1: Configures flicker mitigation to counter artificial-lighting flicker: Off (disabled), Auto detection, or Manual selection of 50 Hz / 60 Hz mains frequency.

tooltip: Denoise Strength – Enables or disables noise reduction.
content1: Enables or disables the camera's noise reduction (denoise) processing.

tooltip: Roll Control – Adjusts the image roll (rotation) value.
content1: Sets the image roll value, from 0 to 180.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the camera serial number.
Firmware Version – Reads the camera firmware version.
ISP Firmware Version – Reads the image signal processor's firmware version.
content1: Displays the ISP's four-part firmware version (major.minor1.minor2.minor3).

tooltip: Default – Restores camera extension controls to factory defaults.
content1: Restores all See3CAM_CU27 extension-unit controls to their factory default values.
